prompt: Jump across floating islands in the clouds to reach the sky castle

intent.setting: A vast skyscape of glowing, drifting stone islands, cloud decks, and broken stone bridges leading to a towering sky castle at the horizon.
intent.role: A nimble cloud-runner able to leap between elevated islands and hover briefly in midair.
intent.goal: Traverse every floating island in the correct order, chaining jumps across gaps and up to the highest point, until you land on the sky castle's entrance terrace.
intent.fail: Missing a jump and falling into the clouds below resets you to the nearest checkpoint island.
intent.mood: Wondrous, airy, and exhilarating, with a sense of vertigo and open-sky freedom.
intent.headline: Floating islands have variable gaps sized to need precise, chained jumps up to the final sky castle terrace
